hook: That water on your seat isn't from the roof.
standingNegativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.vo: Water dripping from your headliner after it rains? Might not be a roof leak.
beats.prompt: macro slow motion water droplet forming and falling from a car headliner seam onto a fabric car seat, interior car cabin, soft window light, shallow depth of field, cinematic, photorealistic

beats.vo: Most sunroofs have four drain tubes that carry rainwater down through the pillars.
beats.prompt: close up exterior shot of car sunroof glass panel, rain droplets beading and running toward the front corner drain channel, wet reflective glass, overcast daylight, photorealistic

beats.vo: Leaves and dirt can clog one, so water backs up instead of draining out.
beats.prompt: extreme close up of a narrow plastic drain tube opening inside a car door pillar, partially clogged with small leaf debris and dirt, water pooling against the blockage, macro detail, photorealistic

beats.vo: That backup finds the easiest way in — usually the headliner or a rear pillar.
beats.prompt: interior car cabin, water beading and dripping from a headliner corner trim piece onto a car seat cushion, a small dark water spot spreading on the carpet below, moody interior lighting, photorealistic

beats.vo: One clue: it usually only happens after rain or a car wash — not all the time.
beats.prompt: close up of a small flexible plastic pick tool clearing leaf debris from a car drain tube opening with no hands or human figures visible, water then flowing freely through the cleared tube, macro detail, photorealistic

beats.vo: Worth checking before you assume it's a full roof leak.
beats.prompt: wide shot of a clean dry car sunroof track and headliner interior, cut to water flowing clearly out of a drain tube exit under the vehicle rocker panel onto pavement, photorealistic, cinematic

beats.vo: Stop by and we'll take a look.
beats.prompt: wide static shot of a clean automotive service bay interior, bright even lighting, no visible signage, logos, or text, photorealistic, held static frame

phrasesUsed: stop by and we'll take a look

evidence.note: General automotive mechanism knowledge only, not a sourced businessFacts/EvidenceRecord claim. reel/social is not yet a FactChannel in this repo.
